name: person-research
description: Autonomous digital footprint audit for a named person. Surfaces every publicly findable item across self-published channels (own socials, blogs, code, video, audio), third-party publications (news, interviews, conference talks, papers, patents, court/KvK filings, Wikipedia, mentions), and leaked-but-public sources (breach databases, pastebins). Output is a single self-contained HTML brief with origin badges per item and a prioritized takedown action list so the subject can request removal. Public sources only.
